messages:
Bob (pen-tester): FYI - I found an audit-export authz path that lets a low-priv user create a logging sink that points to external buckets and includes customer identifiers. Repro steps + sample logs below.

Bob (pen-tester): repro:
```
# create service account with only logging.viewer
gcloud iam service-accounts create tmp-sa
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:tmp-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/logging.viewer"

# attempt to create export sink
gcloud logging sinks create tmp-sink storage.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-prod/buckets/tmp-bucket \
  --log-filter="resource.type=\"ml.googleapis.com\""
```
Result: sink created without requiring logging.configWriter or equivalent. Sink owner could point to external bucket and receive logs (sample attached).

Sarah L: this looks potentially exfil of PII. Can you drop exact sample entries + timestamps and evidence link?

Bob (pen-tester): uploaded sample logs: s3://redwood-pen-tests/1769012345/audit-sample.json (contains request ids and customer IDs). Screen cap of sink creation also attached.

Mike H: I can push a quick IAM guard to require logging.configWriter for sink creation (deny unless has role). Preparing a PR.

Jess P: Product — what's the blast radius? Cross-tenant? Any live customers affected?

Kevin S: support — we have ticket #5479 that mentioned unexpected exported logs last week. I'll attach the ticket thread.

Ana C: Compliance: classify as potential data exfil. Legal needs to review if confirmed. Please do not delete evidence.

Mike H: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/1234 . Policy change: deny logging.sinks.create unless caller has roles/logging.configWriter. Plan deploy: 03:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy started for infra-config @1769014000

Bob (pen-tester): retesting now.

Bob (pen-tester): retest output:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.logging.sinks.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller does not have permission logging.sinks.create
```

Bob (pen-tester): can't reproduce the sink-creation path after the change. Uploaded retest evidence: s3://redwood-pen-tests/1769012345/retest-evidence.json

Sarah L: good. Please include MD5 and signed hash for artifacts and timestamped CLI output. Also need attestations for prod rollout window.

Bob (pen-tester): will add hashes and a short signed note.

Jess P: given the fix and no confirmed cross-tenant deliveries yet, Product suggests severity = Medium (fix required; not confirmed wide breach).

Sarah L: Security ranks this as High due to the ability to point exports to external buckets and the presence of customer identifiers in sample logs. Recommend legal/customer notification assessment.

Ana C: Compliance proposes interim step: assess affected customers and prepare notification plan; legal to advise on timing (aim: within 72 hours if confirmed).

Kevin S: I'll correlate support tickets and surface any matching customer IDs to Product.

Sarah L: Action owners / next steps:
- Mike H: confirm IAM policy deployed to all regions and cloud projects (owner: Mike H)
- Bob (pen-tester): provide final retest artifacts + hashes (owner: Bob)
- Ana C: coordinate with Legal/Compliance for notification decision (owner: Ana C)
- Kevin S: correlate support tickets to customer IDs (owner: Kevin S)
- Jess P: finalize severity and decide on customer outreach (owner: Jess P)
I'll open a follow-up incident doc and add links to artifacts.

Mike H: ack.

Bob (pen-tester): ack — will upload MD5 and signed hashes shortly.
